requirements.description: User wants the property near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74. The commercial unit itself (115 sqm, 15-person capacity, energy class D or better, Turin) is a building requirement and is not covered here.
The user explicitly specified a minimum gross floor area of 115 sqm.

User prefers energy class D or better, so the energy class must be D, C, B or any A class. Floor area, capacity, Turin location, childcare use and proximity to parks are not energy requirements and are excluded here.
